title: THE GLORY OF THE UNSEEN GOD BY PASTOR SAKI, VIWE NIKITA

slides.label: Verse 1
lines: The glory of the unseen God,
The Light of lights, the wisdom of life
Word of truth, so unfailing,
The Icon of our faith,
We delight in Your praiseChristian & Gospel Music

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: You’re the One true God,
Your awesome splendour,
none can deny

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: You’re the God most exalted,
In the heavens and earth,
You are awesomely great

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Prince of peace, adorned with grace,
You are our Lord and King
The solid rock on which we stand today,
The God of our victoryLoveworld Singers Merchandise

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: You are the head of the Church
Firstborn from the dead,
The start of eternity

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: In You we live and move
And have our being,
Holy Lamb of God

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: Our buckler, strength and shield,
The God who leads us triumphantly
No force can withstand the power we have in You,
Holy God

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: We conquer kingdoms in Your name,
We’re seated with You in majesty
Far above the systems of this world
Lord Jesus, You are strong and mighty indeed
